gen-gf-goldman-gf-nokora: Nokora lays down a thick, dark band of lowercase with an s that never pinches shut, plain sans through and through. Goldman's wide, confident capitals above it make that texture feel steady over a full page.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Goldman spreads its bold letters wide, with round forms like open parentheses and a lowercase that towers over its capitals. Noto Kufi Arabic follows quietly, its open-mouthed c and level capitals giving the heading room to lead.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans: Wide, loud, and sure of itself. Goldman's round, parenthesis-like forms take the front, while Noto Sans fills the lines beneath with lowercase that nearly reaches cap height and a generously open c.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Goldman stretches its letters wide with generous clearance, and its lowercase stands unusually tall beside the capitals. Noto Sans Adlam supplies the plain sans counterweight.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjoin: Wide, bold, and a bit brash. Goldman's open-parenthesis curves set the tone, and Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined settles in below with generous gaps between curve ends and stems and barely any height gap between cases.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-hi: Goldman's round, open-parenthesis forms, set wide with plenty of clearance, give it a commanding look from the first word. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs is the sans-serif that does the reading, with outward-pointing tips and tall lowercase.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Goldman arrives wide and bold, with round forms like open parentheses. Noto Sans Arabic carries a longer stretch of text comfortably, thanks to its pronounced x-height and wide openings on the small letters.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Noto Sans Armenian reads friendly and businesslike, its c, s and z standing tall and full. Goldman does the commanding, with wide-set letters and round parenthesis-like forms, while the sans simply keeps the text inviting.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Goldman's widely set, parenthesis-round letters and oversized lowercase make an assertive opening. Noto Sans Avestan answers by being the readable one, its curve tips left open and its x-height pronounced.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Wide, bold, and unmistakably Goldman. Noto Sans Balinese follows with short ascenders and a breathing space inside every curve, so a longer passage would move along without feeling crowded.
